dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I put it on my tab?

dialogues.speaker: Grigory
dialogues.text: Haha, come now, dear customer, you hardly look poor. And besides, small outfits like ours need to run tight budgets, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Grigory
dialogues.text: But in all seriousness, when we say "credit," we mean helping villagers who struggle to make ends meet. People like you aren't who that service is for, you see.
